verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Groq serves an llms.txt at console.groq.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) indexing its docs pages. Docs are also served as raw markdown via .md URLs, for example overview.md, which returned HTTP 200, plus the many docs pages cited at .md paths. This gives an agent agent-oriented documentation it can be pointed at directly. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs, and evidence of how complete the llms.txt index is (e.g. an llms-full.txt variant).
